morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic sector faces volatile fuel costs and export pressures despite natural gas relief.
what_changed: Morbi ceramic industry secured a Rs 5 discount on natural gas prices dropping from Rs 82.
Propane gas prices surged by Rs 7,300 per metric tonne creating immediate margin pressure.
Sector experienced rising gas prices alongside an alleged 50% decline in exports.
stress_signals: Propane-fired vitrified and wall tile manufacturing kilns face direct margin pressure from a Rs 7,300 per tonne price surge [2f37d34283cf].
A large suspicious stock of imported coal was discovered inside a closed ceramic factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC [f675c060fa53].
Industry faces a major blow driven by rising gas prices and a reported 50% drop in exports [c2e1d2a72338].
improvement_signals: Natural gas prices for the Morbi ceramic industry dropped from Rs 82 following a Rs 5 discount [279312659941].
Kajaria Ceramics reported a beat on both sales and profit estimates for Q2 2026 [c28b87e03125].
what_to_watch: Monitor full pricing structures and effective dates for the natural gas price discount.
Track export volume trends and inventory levels across units to assess liquidity risks.
Check account-level working capital utilization for propane-fired kilns facing input cost shocks.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces pre-diwali liquidity stress and power cuts amid technical textile diversification.
what_changed: Surat textile units commenced production of defence fabrics for the Indian Army alongside traditional manufacturing.
Pre-diwali power cuts across Gujarat threatened industrial output, with the textile sector facing estimated weekly losses of Rs 300 crore.
Diamond units reported defaults, closures with untraceable owners, and unpaid wages ahead of Diwali.
stress_signals: A textile mill owner was defrauded of Rs 1.69 crore via a broker [25d6a0f6dbec].
Diamond units shut down with owners untraceable and unpaid salaries pending [8cfd5e03a794, 402ab705574d].
A diamond industrialist defaulted involving crores of rupees right before Diwali [8f729a2b282e].
Textile units faced labor shortages, rising production costs, and insufficient market demand [0bc3ac5bf041].
improvement_signals: Surat expanded into defence fabrics, boosting technical textile manufacturing [c4aec155608f, 4966bee026d8].
Mercedes-Benz explored a technical textile collaboration with MANTRA [3a4ce1852d7c].
Gems exporters worked to rebuild US business and explore new markets [37e6ab2a18cd].
what_to_watch: Monitor pre-Diwali artisan wage clearance and default contagion across diamond cutting and polishing units.
Track the resolution of power supply stability and industrial output losses in textile processing zones.
Evaluate commercial order inflows and execution timelines for units venturing into defence and technical textiles.
